review_candidates.title: ATM Application Support Specialist / Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position Summary The ATM Application Support Specialist / Engineer is responsible for ensuring the high availability, security, and operational efficiency of ATM and self-service terminal software. The role supports the integration between ATM applications, payment switch systems, and core banking systems, while troubleshooting transaction issues, managing software deployments, and ensuring compliance with applicable security standards. Key Responsibilities • Support, configure, and maintain ATM terminal applications, including NCR APTRA, Diebold Nixdorf Vantara/ProTopas, KAL K3A, and Wincor. • Monitor and support integrations between ATM software, payment switches, and core banking systems. • Manage the deployment of screen flows, state tables, software packages, patches, and firmware updates across the ATM fleet. • Diagnose and resolve L2/L3 application issues, communication failures, hardware driver faults, and transaction timeouts. • Investigate transaction disputes, failed cash dispensing, and dispensing discrepancies using electronic journals, switch logs, and trace files. • Support High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) procedures for ATM application servers and switch gateways. • Ensure compliance with PCI-DSS, PA-DSS, EMV Level 1 & 2, and applicable cybersecurity requirements. • Maintain security controls including encryption, access controls, TLS communications, key management, and anti-skimming controls. • Perform security patching and vulnerability remediation for ATM operating systems and applications. • Coordinate with ATM vendors, software providers, payment processors, and internal teams to resolve issues and minimize ATM downtime. Qualifications & Experience • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field. • 3–5+ years of experience in application support within banking, electronic payments, or financial technology environments, with specific experience in ATM networks. • ITIL Foundation, PCI-DSS Awareness, Certified Payment Professional (CPP), or ATM platform certifications are preferred. Technical Skills • Experience with ATM technologies such as NDC+, DDC, CEN/XFS, NCR APTRA, Diebold Vantara/ProBase, KAL, or equivalent platforms. • Knowledge of ISO 8583, TCP/IP, X.25, RESTful APIs, and SOAP web services. • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, and SQL querying. • Familiarity with Windows Server and Linux environments.
